text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, they choose tasks from a backlog, which is a prioritized list of user stories describing what users need. Every day, the team holds a short meeting called a standup to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to deliver small parts of the product regularly, get feedback, and improve continuously. As a result, Agile helps teams respond quickly to changes and build better products.
